findings.title: Scope raw counts to the requested product
findings.description: `raw_counts` counts every `tick_trade` row in the requested time window, while `ledger_totals` is filtered to the selected product’s request shape. Once the tick database contains more than one product, coverage for each product will include other products’ rows as raw-only mismatches. This will affect the default all-products command as well as `--product`; restrict the raw scan to the selected shape’s instruments.

findings.title: Missing calendar configuration is reported as a storage outage
findings.description: The read path passes `calendar_url(settings)` into the calendar read. When the production DB URL is unset, `calendar_url` raises `TickCalendarError`, which `exit_code_for` maps to storage exit 4. The status/coverage contract and `READ_EPILOG` classify configuration problems as preflight exit 1, reserving 4 for an unreachable database. Map the missing setting to preflight rather than outage.

findings.title: Calendar pool timeouts escape the storage error mapping
findings.description: `calendar_sessions` translates `psycopg.OperationalError`, but not `psycopg_pool.PoolTimeout`. If the production calendar connection pool cannot provide a connection before its timeout, that exception is not mapped by `exit_code_for` and escapes as a traceback instead of the documented storage exit 4. Handle the pool timeout as a calendar storage failure.

findings.title: Add a load test for the coverage read path
findings.description: Coverage performs a raw `tick_trade` count over a user-selected date range, but the added tests exercise correctness only; the load test in the project covers ingest, not this read path. Because this database/network path can scan a large hypertable, add a realistic load test with an explicit latency or resource bound.
